name: LinkedIn Profile Analysis - Game Development
description: Signals extracted from LinkedIn profiles to evidence Game Development skills. LinkedIn provides professional context, endorsements, and career trajectory data.

sections.notes: Self-described; provides intent and self-assessment context. Look for specific engine/language mentions.

sections.description: Work experience entries with job titles, companies, and descriptions.
sections.notes: Look for game development-related job titles and descriptions at known studios.
quality_indicators: Game dev job titles (Game Programmer, Engine Programmer, Technical Artist, Gameplay Engineer)
Studio reputation and size (AAA vs indie)

sections.description: Skills listed with endorsement counts from connections.
sections.notes: Endorsements have very low evidential value. However, the skill list provides self-reported skill claims.
Same as CV certifications — theoretical knowledge indicator, not practical proof.

sections.description: Projects section with descriptions and links.
sections.notes: Links to itch.io, Steam, or GitHub increase strength. Game jam entries are valuable.

sections.description: Written recommendations from colleagues or managers.
sections.notes: Third-party validation of skills. Look for specific technical skill mentions from industry peers.

sections.description: Technical posts and articles published on LinkedIn.
sections.notes: Indicates thought leadership and depth of knowledge in game development topics.

signal_mapping.description: How LinkedIn mentions map to skill evidence using COMPOSITE KEYS ({skill_id}.{subskill_id}). AI should use these patterns.

patterns.pattern: LinkedIn skills endorsement for 'Unity' or 'Unreal Engine'
LinkedIn skills endorsement for 'Game Design' or 'Game Development'
Job experience explicitly describing gameplay systems programming
Job experience describing rendering or shader work at a game studio
Engine Programmer or Systems Programmer role at game studio
Technical Artist role with tool pipeline development
Posts or articles about game development technical topics
Graphics Programmer or Shader Artist role
Network Programmer or Online Services Engineer at game studio
Performance optimization or profiling experience at game studio
Build Engineer or Release Manager at game studio
Game Designer or Level Designer role with systems design
AI Programmer with behavior tree or GOAP experience

important_notes: ALL extracted signals MUST be mapped to COMPOSITE KEYS ({skill_id}.{subskill_id})
LinkedIn data supplements but should not override GitHub or assessment evidence
Endorsements have near-zero evidential value on their own
Job titles in game industry are less standardized than other fields — cross-reference with responsibilities
Career trajectory (indie → studio, junior → lead) provides context for level assessment
Look for technical content creation (posts, articles, talks at GDC/Unite/Unreal Fest) as evidence of deep understanding
Studio pedigree (AAA studios like Ubisoft, Epic, Naughty Dog) can indicate exposure to production-grade pipelines
